title: ControlNet as Topology
hero_prompt: A wide chalk-and-charcoal Renaissance sculptor's-studio drawing: a bent wire armature in a striding pose stands inside a half-carved block of marble, the figure's form just emerging around the wire from raw stone and chisel strokes in warm sepia chalk, no people, no hands. icon_prompt: A bold, high-contrast icon: a wire armature bent into a single striding figure's pose, drawn as one thick black chisel-cut line against a bare marble-white ground, no hatching.
